title: Chapter 80
text: COMMUNITY MEMORY is the name we give to this experimental information service. It is an attempt to harness the power of the computer in the service of the community. We hope to do this by providing a sort of super bulletin board where people can post notices of all sorts and can find the notices posted by others rapidly. 12 True to their motto, “Technology for the People,” Resource One outlines their goals for the project, betraying a community-oriented, no-nonsense optimism about the promise of a computer network:
